description: QoreX is a curious, collaborative team passionate about space, astronomy and useful technology. We enjoy exploring big questions, learning new tools and turning ideas into working solutions. For the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge, we aim to make sky observations easier to explore and compare over time. We're looking for teammates skilled in astronomy, Python, AI/ML, web development, data science, UI/UX or research—and, above all, curious, creative people willing to learn and build together.
